description: Know-your-business and e-invoice checks for EU counterparties in one call: official company registers, VAT (VIES) validation, sanctions screening and invoice format rules. USE FOR: - Verifying that an EU company exists and its VAT number is valid before paying an invoice - Screening a company or address against sanctions lists - Checking whether an XRechnung or ZUGFeRD e-invoice will be accepted TRIGGERS: - "verify this company", "KYB", "VAT number check", "VIES validation" - "sanctions screening", "is this counterparty sanctioned" - "XRechnung validator", "ZUGFeRD check", "e-invoice valid" Sold as x402/MPP pay-per-call tools on Base and Solana; agents pay per successful call.
